About Webnify

One team for design, build and growth

Webnify Technologies is a full-service web studio. We design and build custom websites, Shopify stores, WordPress and CMS platforms — then handle the SEO, speed and growth that keep them performing. One team, from the first mockup to launch and beyond.

No page-builder bloat and no templates — just clean, custom-coded work, designed around your brand and your customers, and built to load fast, rank higher and convert better.

  • Custom web development — Shopify, WordPress, WooCommerce, Next.js & React
  • UI/UX design you approve before we write a line of code
  • SEO, speed optimization and conversion built into every project

What we do

Everything your website needs

From a single landing page to a full custom platform, store or CMS build — plus the SEO to help it grow. We handle the design and the code.

01

Custom Web Development

Full custom websites, web apps and headless builds in clean, scalable code — not page-builder templates. Built for speed, security and easy editing by your team, with analytics and third-party integrations wired in from day one so your site is ready to grow.

Web apps & dashboards Headless & APIs Clean, scalable code
02

Shopify Development

Custom Liquid themes, OS 2.0 sections, B2B and app integrations built to scale with your sales — fast storefronts that convert and stay easy to manage. From theme to checkout, every detail is tuned for conversion and a smooth customer experience.

Custom Liquid themes OS 2.0 sections B2B & app integrations
03

WordPress & CMS

WordPress, WooCommerce and other CMS builds — content-rich, flexible and easy for your team to manage, with custom blocks and templates built around your workflow. Secure, up to date and simple to extend as your business grows.

WordPress & WooCommerce Custom blocks Editor-friendly
04

SEO & Growth

Technical SEO, on-page optimization, structured data and content that climbs the search rankings — so the site you launch keeps bringing in traffic and leads, backed by clear reporting so you always see exactly what is working.

Technical SEO On-page & content Structured data
05

Speed Optimization

PageSpeed and Core Web Vitals fixes and asset optimization for a faster site that ranks better and converts more. We profile, fix and re-test on real devices — from Lighthouse scores to real-world load times on real connections.

Core Web Vitals Asset optimization Real-device testing
06

UI / UX & Design

Homepage mockups, product-page design, brand kits and design systems that make your site look premium — approved by you before a single line of code is written. Pixel-perfect and fully responsive across every device and screen size.

Homepage & page design Brand kits Design systems
